title: Docs: add “First production launch” guide + update onboarding navigation to match Console checklist
author: Wei Chen
description: Summary: This PR creates a new canonical doc page for “First production launch” and updates the docs navigation + onboarding landing pages to align with the in-Console guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1: Hosted API, self-serve). Motivation: During discovery we saw users complete “first request” but stall on the path to production (retries/timeouts, rate limits/429 handling, monitoring, and safe rollout). Support tickets also show recurring confusion around test vs prod keys and what “production-ready” means. This doc provides a single place to define the minimum bar and link out to deeper references, and the nav updates ensure the checklist deep-links land on stable, discoverable pages. What’s included: 1) New guide page: /docs/guides/first-production-launch (owned by DevEx docs). Covers: definition of “production launch” for Hosted API; checklist-style sections (API key hygiene: test vs prod; timeouts + retries; rate limits/quotas + 429 handling; monitoring/usage analytics; rollouts/canary + rollback/fallback); minimal snippets and “copy/paste” recommendations (request IDs, structured errors); and a final “Launch criteria” section that matches the Console checklist wording. 2) Navigation updates: adds “First production launch” under Get started → Production readiness; reorders onboarding section to mirror checklist sequence (API key → first request → streaming/structured output → error handling → usage + limits → production launch). 3) Landing page refresh: updates /docs/get-started to include a “Production path” card linking to the new guide, and clarifies that the checklist is available in Console (feature-flagged). 4) Deep-link conventions: adds UTM parameters on Console-originated doc links (utm_source=console&utm_medium=onboarding_checklist&utm_campaign=guided_onboarding) and ensures the target URLs are version-stable (no ephemeral headings-only links). 5) Redirects: adds redirect entries for previous draft URLs referenced in internal notes (e.g., /docs/production-checklist → /docs/guides/first-production-launch) to avoid 404s during beta. Out of scope: Dedicated/Private specifics, SSO/SAML onboarding, and exhaustive validation guidance for every deployment mode (tracked separately). Testing: ran docs build locally; verified sidebar/nav ordering; verified redirects; validated all internal links on the new page. Note: the code snippets here intentionally stay lightweight and link to SDK parity updates in PR #1920 for the canonical auth/retry/streaming examples.
commits: docs(guides): add first-production-launch guide (structure + minimum bar)
docs(nav): update sidebar ordering to mirror onboarding checklist sequence
docs(landing): refresh get-started page with production path card + copy tweaks
docs(redirects): add redirects for older production checklist draft URLs
chore(links): fix broken anchors + normalize UTM parameters
review_conversation: Elliot Price (review): The structure is good and matches the checklist. Please tighten the definition of “production launch” to avoid implying an SLA. Also make sure we’re consistent about “project” vs “org” terminology (Console uses project-scoped keys).

Wei Chen (author): Updated the intro + definition block to explicitly say this is a minimum bar (not an SLA) and replaced a few “workspace/org” references with “project” where relevant. Also added a short note on scoping: keys are project-scoped; billing/usage roll up at org level.

Nikhil Sharma (review): In the rate limits section, can we be explicit that 429 can be burst or sustained quota, and that retries need jitter/backoff? Also link to the quotas page instead of describing the UI in detail (Console is changing).

Wei Chen (author): Done. Added a short taxonomy (burst vs sustained) + a recommended backoff pattern (w/ jitter) and replaced the UI walkthrough with a stable link to limits/quotas + a single screenshot-free description.

Marissa Cole (review): Please add a callout that Console has an onboarding checklist (beta/flagged) and that users may see different step availability depending on rollout. Also ensure the UTM tags match DES-115.
Wei Chen (author): Added the Console checklist callout + a one-liner on beta availability. UTM params updated to match DES-115 exactly (source/medium/campaign).
Tessa Morgan (review): Tone request: remove “you must” language; use “recommended minimum” / “strongly recommended” for clarity. Also make the headings more scannable (verbs).
Wei Chen (author): Updated microcopy to be less absolute, and reworked headings (e.g., “Set timeouts” / “Add retries with backoff” / “Instrument usage + errors”).
Monica Patel (review): Snippets: avoid duplicating SDK-specific retry helpers here since those are being standardized in PR #1920. Prefer pseudo-code plus a link to the canonical SDK examples page.
Wei Chen (author): Adjusted snippets to pseudo-code + links to the SDK examples section, and added a note that helpers differ by language until PR #1920 lands.
Elliot Price (approval): Approved. Please ensure redirects are included for the old /docs/production-checklist path; otherwise Support macros will break during beta.
Wei Chen (author): Confirmed redirect entry added and link-check passes.

release_notes: Docs: Added a new “First production launch” guide for Hosted API users and updated onboarding navigation/landing pages to align with the Console guided checklist.
